item.title: Golden Retriever Guide: Temperament, History, Health, and Training
item.description: A Golden Retriever has a way of making a house feel warmer before anyone says a word. The soft eyes, the waving tail, the hopeful lean against your knee, they all point to the same thing: this breed was built for connection.
